$comment: The design-authority manifest (task 028). One current record per governed surface, naming the owner-approved HTML pack that owns that surface's visual anatomy and the SHA-256 of its exact bytes. src/ui/design-authority.test.ts fails when a canonical file, a hash, or a record here drifts. The packs own composition, hierarchy, density, placement, disclosure, table/row treatment, status presentation, interaction and responsive behaviour; they do NOT own product copy (docs/design/content.json) and they do NOT own technical truth (the engine, the baseline, Graph, lifecycle, MFA proof). Current production is NOT assumed to match: task 028 established the authority, packs 030+ do the restoration. The brand skin is recorded in docs/design/brand-decisions.md and the forensic record in docs/design/authority-reconciliation.md.

precedence.$comment: Resolution order when two authorities appear to disagree. Truth outranks the picture; the picture outranks the skin. A design that appears to require a different technical meaning does not get one: the design adapts, or the bounded sub-item stops.

surfaces.name: Plan
surfaces.sourceNameNote: The (1) is upload provenance from the owner's original file name only. The canonical repository file name drops it; nothing may reintroduce a second current Plan pack under the (1) name.

brand.$comment: The approved brand skin. It may repaint the approved anatomy; it may not rearrange it.

generatedPreviews.$comment: Application-page previews produced during the branding exploration. They are brand/colour framing only. This manifest deliberately records no path for them: a generated preview is never an entry in `surfaces`, and nothing may promote one to an application authority.

renderedEvidence.$comment: Passing code and tests cannot prove visual conformance. A restoration task compares the rendered surface with its pack.
